name: BCIT Digital Arts, Media, and Design (DAMD) Mural
description: BCIT's Design, Art, and Media department invited students to leave their mark on an Interior Space Design Project centered on creative connection. The theme: every discipline overlaps; every person belongs to something larger than their own work.

modules.content:
CHALLENGE

How do you represent the full breadth of the creative industry without flattening what makes each discipline unique? How do you show that every student, every program, is part of one bigger picture?

SOLUTION

Every DAMD program was mapped to a symbol or tool native to its craft. Wirefgrames for New Media, 3D prints for 3D Modelling, and so on. The concept came naturally; being a Bachelor of Creative Industries student made this topic personal.
